description: ADO-PERSIST: a client static batch-optimistic recordset of K is saved as ADTG, then given a pending local change (row 1 T = "pending") and saved as ADTG and XML (files kept); the pending ADTG and the XML are reopened connectionless with adCmdFile (State, RecordCount, Status, T Value/OriginalValue and every row); then an explicit Provider=MSPersist Connection opens, a Recordset opens the plain ADTG through it, and Connection.Execute is called with the ADTG path. Asks what each route accepts and restores.
retentionNote: Designed r-str-ado-act probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
